{{Quote|Okay, buddy, your funeral. Down Palpatine Boulevard about a kilometer, hang a left, and three blocks onto Imperium.|An individual gives directions to the Imperial Message Center|<ref name="RPG" />}}
'''Imperium''' was the location of the [[Imperial Message Center]]. [[Palpatine Boulevard]] was three blocks away from it. An individual once asked for directions to the Imperial Message Center, and was given the directions via Palpatine Boulevard and Imperium.<ref name="RPG" />
